defined_text = {
	name = JxpStartRoleChronicle
	random = no

	text = {
		localisation_key = jxp_start_age_discovery_role_shogunate
		trigger = {
			current_age = age_of_discovery
			has_reform = shogunate
		}
	}

	text = {
		localisation_key = jxp_start_age_discovery_role_daimyo
		trigger = {
			current_age = age_of_discovery
			OR = { has_reform = daimyo has_reform = indep_daimyo }
			NOT = { has_reform = shogunate }
		}
	}

	text = {
		localisation_key = jxp_start_age_discovery_role_realm
		trigger = {
			current_age = age_of_discovery
		}
	}

	text = {
		localisation_key = jxp_start_age_reformation_role_shogunate
		trigger = {
			current_age = age_of_reformation
			has_reform = shogunate
		}
	}

	text = {
		localisation_key = jxp_start_age_reformation_role_daimyo
		trigger = {
			current_age = age_of_reformation
			OR = { has_reform = daimyo has_reform = indep_daimyo }
			NOT = { has_reform = shogunate }
		}
	}

	text = {
		localisation_key = jxp_start_age_reformation_role_realm
		trigger = {
			current_age = age_of_reformation
		}
	}

	text = {
		localisation_key = jxp_start_age_absolutism_role_shogunate
		trigger = {
			current_age = age_of_absolutism
			has_reform = shogunate
		}
	}

	text = {
		localisation_key = jxp_start_age_absolutism_role_daimyo
		trigger = {
			current_age = age_of_absolutism
			OR = { has_reform = daimyo has_reform = indep_daimyo }
			NOT = { has_reform = shogunate }
		}
	}

	text = {
		localisation_key = jxp_start_age_absolutism_role_realm
		trigger = {
			current_age = age_of_absolutism
		}
	}

	text = {
		localisation_key = jxp_start_age_revolutions_role_shogunate
		trigger = {
			current_age = age_of_revolutions
			has_reform = shogunate
		}
	}

	text = {
		localisation_key = jxp_start_age_revolutions_role_daimyo
		trigger = {
			current_age = age_of_revolutions
			OR = { has_reform = daimyo has_reform = indep_daimyo }
			NOT = { has_reform = shogunate }
		}
	}

	text = {
		localisation_key = jxp_start_age_revolutions_role_realm
		trigger = {
			current_age = age_of_revolutions
		}
	}

	text = {
		localisation_key = jxp_start_age_fallback_role_realm
		trigger = {
			always = yes
		}
	}
